text:
sam_support: FYI escalation from ACME Health — they say they started ingesting PHI 48h ago and now require a signed BAA, 7-year retention for audit logs, and a KMS/HSM separation plan. They want incident-response SLA and immediate access to audit trails.

ethan_custsuccess: Copy of customer's ask pasted from email: "Need BAA + HIPAA addendum, full audit logs for all API calls (including request/response bodies) for 3/12-3/14, KMS with customer-managed keys (HSM-backed if possible), retention 7 years, and IR contact. Can you provide a path to comply within 72h?"

priya_security: @sam_support blocking q: is this tenant on Hosted or Dedicated/Private? also need tenant id and any example request_ids. We must avoid returning raw PHI in exports until legal signs BAA. :eyes:

sam_support: Hosted (us-west-2). Tenant: acme-health-prod. Example request id they highlighted: req_0a3b9f2c. They claim bodies contain PHI. Customer turned off "store" flag in app front-end but still used embeddings endpoint for ingestion.

victor_eng: I can pull audit events. Current hosted audit retention defaults to 90 days. We don't have 7-year retention on Hosted by default. CLI to fetch (internal):
```
redwood logs --tenant acme-health-prod --from 2025-03-12 --to 2025-03-14 --type audit --output jsonl > acme-audit-3-12-14.jsonl
```
Will need legal sign-off before sharing payloads.

nina_legal: We have a standard BAA template but we need DPA + BAA signed before providing anything that could be PHI. 7-year retention is unusual but possible as an addendum for enterpise customers — depends on infrastructure commitment (may need Dedicated or Private). I'll draft the addendum and confirm scope.

priya_security: Quick note on keys/HSM: Hosted currently supports Redwood-managed keys and customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS) for encryption-at-rest. HSM-backed BYOK (customer HSM) is only supported in Private deployments today. Short-term options: (1) enable CMK with customer AWS account (we store only encrypted key envelope), (2) stream audit logs to customer-owned S3 bucket + KMS, (3) ephemeral token rotation and stricter IAM.

ethan_custsuccess: Customer asked specifically if we can stream unredacted request/response bodies to their S3. They want full bodies. Reminder: customer is pushing for timeline — they asked for a 72h compliance path.

priya_security: Do NOT share raw PHI in logs. Recommended interim deliverable: metadata-rich audit export (request_id, timestamp, route, model, latency, status, bytes_in/out) + redacted payloads where PHI is masked or replaced with deterministic hash. If they insist on full bodies, we need BAA signed and prefer to set up a direct S3 export into their account (so data goes straight to their bucket, encrypted with their CMK).

victor_eng: I can prepare an S3 export pipeline and a redaction-runner. Sample redaction snippet (internal):
```
# redact PHI - naive example
jq '.body |= (if (.text|test("\\b(SSN|DOB|patient)\\b";"i")) then "[REDACTED]" else .body end)' acme-audit-3-12-14.jsonl > acme-audit-redacted.jsonl
```
Will need an IAM role from the customer for cross-account PUTs if we stream to their bucket.

nina_legal: Next steps from legal side: I'll email the BAA draft, include scope that audit logs will be provided as metadata + redacted payloads by default. If customer requires unredacted payloads in their S3, we'll make it an addendum requiring Dedicated/Private or explicit infra change & infra approval.

sam_support: Action plan: (1) nina to send BAA + addendum draft to customer today, (2) priya to prepare redaction guidance and an export of metadata-only logs within 24h, (3) victor to stand up S3 export pipeline (customer role required) and estimate time/constraints for full unredacted export. ETA: 24-48h for initial deliverables.

pagerduty-bot: Incident created: INC-20250314-ACMEHIPAA assigned to @priya_security (priority: high).

ethan_custsuccess: I'll coordinate with customer to get their AWS bucket + IAM role and push for signed BAA. Keeping customer updated on ETA.

priya_security: I'll prepare a redaction script + checklist for the export (fields to include: request_id, ts, endpoint, model, status, latency, bytes). Will not include response bodies until BAA & infra approvals.

sam_support: Thanks — I'll keep thread updated and escalate to product if customer pushes for 7-year retention on Hosted. :thumbsup:
